demos.name: Poppy Verification
demos.description: Check a Company and its issuer against the Personal Agent Protocol 1.0: 107 spec-linked checks (discovery, issuer metadata, Poppy-Session, sign-in, resources). Mock runs a reference Company you can break with 28 defects; Real probes the Company you type.
demos.notes: Fork of poppy-agent-tester-LAB. Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7821). Docker: HOST_PORT=7821 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only); starts in Mock, and Real needs PVL_AGENT_BASE_URL (see docs/setup.md). Mock opens no socket. Not a certification.
